ai_summary: Here is a 2-3 sentence executive summary:  3P LAND HOLDINGS LTD. has issued its seventh reminder to shareholders holding physical shares, urging them to update mandatory KYC details including PAN, bank, and nomination information in compliance with SEBI regulations. Non-compliant shareholders are already ineligible for dividend payments and other electronic transactions since April 1, 2024, and will also have all service requests and complaints withheld. The persistent need for multiple reminders highlights a significant and ongoing issue with shareholder compliance, potentially leading to a large number of inactive accounts and administrative inefficiencies for the company.
